params.body:
The "Gepubliceerd" column in the own-stock list shows how long a published car has been on the stocklist. The wording was "Al 5 dagen" (en "Already", fr "Déjà", de "Schon"), which reads as a reproach that the car has been standing too long. The column only states a duration, so it now reads:

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| nl | Al :count dag/dagen | Sinds :count dag/dagen |
| fr | Déjà :count jour(s) | Depuis :count jour(s) |
| en | Already :count day(s) | For :count day(s) |
| de | Schon :count Tag/Tage | Seit :count Tag/Tagen |

Spanish has no translation for `global.on_stocklist_since_days`, so nothing changes there. Rule S2-2.5 already describes the column as "sinds N dagen", so the business rules need no edit; this brings the screen in line with it.

## Changes
- `resources/lang/{nl,fr,en,de}/global.php`: `on_stocklist_since_days`.
- `tests/Feature/OwnStockRowPublishedDaysTest.php`: asserts "Sinds 1 dag" and "Sinds 5 dagen".

The key has one user (`ownstock/_wagen_rij.blade.php`). Other "Déjà"/"Already"/"Schon" strings (already sold, already requested) mean something else and stay.

## Tests
`OwnStockRowPublishedDaysTest` and `LanguageParityTest` pass locally (the Spanish-gaps report is the existing incomplete notice).
params.title: Published column: "Sinds N dagen" instead of "Al N dagen"
